blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote-sensing foundation models increasingly unify representations across sensing modalities and downstream tasks, yet their prediction mechanisms remain largely task-specific. Separate decoders, prediction heads, and objectives leave prediction fragmented across tasks. This naturally raises a question: can heterogeneous remote-sensing tasks share the prediction process? UniFlow-RS answers this question with a single latent flow-matching predictor shared across tasks. This requires addressing two key challenges: unifying heterogeneous prediction spaces and harmonizing joint optimization across tasks. First, we cast heterogeneous task outputs into structured visual targets in a common latent space, allowing them to be modeled by the same pretrained flow predictor. Task-dependent conditioning further accommodates differences in input configurations. Second, we optimize all tasks with a common Flow Matching objective, eliminating task-specific prediction losses. To mitigate optimization mismatch across tasks and modalities, we introduce Task-Modality Adaptive Timestep Sampling (TMAS), which dynamically allocates training timesteps according to the online learning state of each task-modality group. Using a single shared model, UniFlow-RS handles six tasks and thirteen datasets, surpassing recent task-specific state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks while remaining competitive on the others. Beyond these benchmarks, the same checkpoint demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer across unseen datasets, task settings, occlusion conditions, and near-infrared false-color imagery, without target-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 遥感基础模型越来越统一了各种遥感方式和下游任务之间的表述,但其预测机制在很大程度上仍然是针对具体任务的。 单独的解码器、预测头和目标使预测分散于不同的任务。 这自然引起一个问题:各种遥感任务能否分享预测过程? UniFlow-RS用一个跨任务共享的单一潜在流比预测器来回答这个问题. 这需要应对两个关键挑战:统一不同的预测空间并统一各项任务之间的联合优化。 首先,我们把不同的任务输出投放到一个共同潜在空间的有条理的视觉目标中,使得它们能够被同一预先训练的流量预测器所模拟. 任务依赖条件进一步适应了输入配置的差异. 第二,我们优化所有任务,实现共同的流量匹配目标,消除特定任务预测损失. 为了缓解任务和模式之间的优化不匹配,我们引入了任务-机动性适应时序抽样(TMAS),根据每个任务-模式组的在线学习状况,动态地分配培训时序. 使用单一共享模式,UniFlow-RS处理6个任务和13个数据集,在几个基准上超越了最近特定任务的最新方法,而在其他基准上仍然具有竞争力。 除了这些基准外,同一检查站还显示,在未发现的数据集、任务设置、隔离条件和近红外假彩相片之间进行了强有力的零射传输,但没有针对具体目标的调整。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Remote-sensing interpretation increasingly requires models to operate across diverse tasks, sensing modalities, and input configurations. Discriminative foundation models such as SkySense and MTP ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) have substantially advanced representation reuse across optical, SAR, multi-temporal observations, and downstream tasks. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 (a), most unified models still retain task-specific prediction heads, decoders, or output mechanisms after the shared representation, leaving the final prediction stage fragmented across tasks.
This exposes a remaining gap in unified remote-sensing perception: can heterogeneous remote-sensing tasks share not only representations, but the prediction process itself?
blocks.zh:
遥感解释越来越需要模型来操作各种任务、遥感方式和输入配置。 SkySense和MTP(Guo等人,2024;Wang等人,2024a)等歧视性基础模型在光学、合成孔径雷达、多时观测和下游任务方面具有相当高的再利用性。 然而,如图1(a)所显示的,大多数统一模型仍然保留特定任务预测头,解码器,或共享表示后输出机制,使得最终预测阶段分散于不同任务.
这暴露出统一遥感感知方面仍然存在的差距:不同的遥感任务不仅能分享表述,而且能分享预测过程本身?

blocks.en:
Generative foundation models provide a natural route toward this goal by reformulating prediction as conditional visual generation.
Recent work has shown that pretrained image generators can serve as generalist visual predictors ( Gabeur et al., 2026 ) , while flow matching provides a simple formulation for conditional generation through velocity-based transport ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . In remote sensing, generative models have further demonstrated strong flexibility across sensing modalities and generation settings ( Jakubik et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
This suggests a unified paradigm for generalist remote-sensing perception: encoding diverse structured outputs as visual representations and predicting them with a shared latent flow model.
blocks.zh:
基因基础模型通过将预测重新设定为有条件的视觉生成,为实现这一目标提供了一条自然路线。
最近的工作表明,预先训练的图像生成器可以充当通论视觉预测器(Gabeur等,2026年),而流量匹配则通过以速度为基础的运输为条件生成提供了简单的配方(Lipman等,2023年;Liu等,2023年). 在遥感方面,基因模型在各种遥感模式和生成环境之间进一步显示出了强大的灵活性(Jakubik等,2025;Chen等,2026)。
这表明了通论遥感感知的统一范式:将各种结构化的输出编码为可视化表示并用共享的潜在流模型来预测.

blocks.en: Making this paradigm work in remote sensing requires resolving two key mismatches. The first is a prediction-space and conditioning mismatch . Remote-sensing tasks involve heterogeneous outputs, from binary masks and semantic maps to height fields, referred regions, and rotated instances, with inputs spanning optical/SAR, single-/bi-temporal, and optional text conditioning. A unified predictor must therefore accommodate these heterogeneous output structures and input conditioning configurations without resorting to task-specific branches. The second is an optimization mismatch . Even under a unified prediction formulation, different task–modality groups can exhibit different learning dynamics along the flow trajectory. A fixed timestep distribution imposes the same sampling schedule on groups whose optimization needs may differ substantially.
blocks.zh: 要使这种范式在遥感领域发挥作用,就需要解决两个关键的不匹配问题。 第一个是预测空间和调节不匹配。 遥感任务涉及各种产出,从二进制口罩和语义图到高地、参照区和旋转实例,输入范围包括光学/合成孔径、单相/双相和可选的文字条件。 因此,一个统一的预测器必须适应这些不同的产出结构和输入条件配置,而无需诉诸特定任务的分支. 二是优化不匹配 即使在统一的预测公式下,不同的任务-模式组也可以沿流轨迹显示不同的学习动态. 固定的时间段分布对最优化需求可能存在很大差异的群体规定了同样的取样时间表。

blocks.en:
We introduce UniFlow-RS , a latent-flow framework that addresses these two mismatches with a single generative predictor shared across heterogeneous remote-sensing tasks.
As shown in Figure 1 (b), UniFlow-RS replaces a collection of task-specific predictors with one pretrained latent flow predictor and one shared LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adapter, together with a frozen VAE for target encoding and decoding.
All tasks are trained with the same Flow Matching objective, without learned task-specific output heads or task-specific losses.
To make this shared predictor applicable across tasks, UniFlow-RS maps task-specific structured targets into a common VAE-compatible visual latent space, while different tasks are specified through task-dependent input conditioning. We further design deterministic recovery rules to convert the generated latent outputs back into their native evaluation formats.
Building on this unified prediction space, we address the heterogeneous optimization dynamics across different tasks with Task–Modality Adaptive Timestep Sampling (TMAS).
TMAS dynamically reallocates timestep-level training budget according to the online learning state of each task–modality group, allowing the sampling schedule to adapt to group-specific optimization needs.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了UniFlow-RS, 一种潜在的流量框架,它用一个单一的基因预测器处理这两种不匹配的情况,这个预测器共用于各种不同的遥感任务。
如图1 (b)所显示,UniFlow-RS将一组任务特定预测器替换为一个预先训练出的潜在流预测器和一个共享的LORA(Hu等,2022年)适配器,并配有用于目标编码和解码的被冻结的VAE.
所有任务都以相同的"流量匹配"目标来训练,没有学习到的任务特定产出主管或任务特定损失.
为了使这个共享的预测器适用于跨任务,UniFlow-RS将特定任务的结构化目标映射到一个共同的相容VAE的视觉潜伏空间中,同时通过任务依赖的输入条件来指定不同的任务. 我们进一步设计确定性恢复规则,将产生的潜在产出重新转化为其本土评价格式。
基于这个统一的预测空间,我们用“任务-机动性适应时间步抽样”来处理不同任务之间的各种优化动态。
TMAS根据每个任务-模式组的在线学习状态,动态地重新分配分时级培训预算,使采样时间表能够适应组别特定的优化需要.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 (c), UniFlow-RS covers six remote-sensing tasks across thirteen datasets, spanning optical, SAR, bi-temporal, continuous-output, language-conditioned, and instance-level prediction settings. Despite using a shared LoRA adapter, UniFlow-RS surpasses the best reported results on multiple benchmarks while remaining competitive on the others.
blocks.zh: 如图1(c)所示,UniFlow-RS覆盖了13个数据集的6个遥感任务,包括光学、合成孔径雷达、双时段、连续输出、语言条件和实例级预测设置。 尽管使用了共享的LORA适配器,UniFlow-RS在多个基准上超过了最佳报告结果,而在其他基准上仍然具有竞争力.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce a unified remote-sensing framework in which heterogeneous tasks share the prediction process itself , rather than only representations. A single pretrained latent flow predictor and shared LoRA support six tasks under the same Flow Matching objective, without learned task-specific output heads or losses. • We formulate heterogeneous remote-sensing outputs in a common structured visual space and combine it with task-dependent conditioning, allowing diverse output structures, sensing modalities, and input configurations to be handled by one latent predictor. • We formulate heterogeneous task–modality learning dynamics along the flow trajectory as a timestep-allocation problem and propose TMAS, which adaptively adjusts timestep sampling based on the online learning state of each group, improving joint optimization and convergence.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了一个统一的遥感框架,其中不同的任务共享预测过程本身,而不仅仅是表述。 单一的预先培训的潜在流量预测器和共享的LORA支持同一流量匹配目标下的六项任务,没有学到具体任务的产出头或损失。 我们在一个共同的结构化的视觉空间中制定各种遥感产出,并将其与任务依赖的调制结合起来,使不同的产出结构、感测方式和输入配置由一个潜在的预测器处理。 我们按照流动轨迹制定多样的任务-模式学习动态,作为时间步-分配问题,并提议TMAS,它根据每个群体的在线学习状况,调整时间步抽样,改善联合优化和趋同。

blocks.en:
Pretrained generative models offer transferable visual priors, making them particularly promising for remote sensing, where dense annotations are costly and scarce.
Painter ( Wang et al., 2023 ) unifies visual tasks through masked image modeling, while InstructDiffusion ( Geng et al., 2024 ) and InstructCV ( Gan et al., 2024 ) explore instruction-conditioned diffusion for visual prediction.
FlowDIS ( Sargsyan and Navasardyan, 2026 ) further applies Flow Matching to language-guided segmentation.
However, extending this paradigm to core remote-sensing perception tasks, such as building extraction, change detection, semantic segmentation, and height estimation, remains challenging due to heterogeneous output structures, sensing modalities, input configurations, and optimization dynamics.
We address these challenges through structured visual targets, observation-initialized latent flow prediction, and task–modality adaptive timestep sampling, enabling diverse remote-sensing tasks to share a unified generative prediction process.
blocks.zh:
事先经过训练的基因模型提供了可转移的视觉前科,使它们在遥感方面特别有希望,因为高密度的说明成本高而稀缺。
绘画家(Wang等,2023年)通过蒙面图像模型统一了视觉任务,而InstructDifusion(Geng等,2024年)和InstructCV(Gan等,2024年)则为视觉预测探索了有指导条件的传播.
FlowDIS (Sargsyan and Navasardyan, 2026) 进一步将Flow匹配应用于语言导分.
然而,由于产出结构、感知方式、输入配置和优化动态等多种多样,将这一范式推广到核心遥感感知任务,如建筑提取、变化探测、语义分解和高度估计,仍然具有挑战性。
我们通过结构化的视觉目标、观察初始化的潜在流预测和任务模式适应时间步骤取样来应对这些挑战,使各种遥感任务能够共享统一的基因预测过程。

blocks.en:
Multi-task optimization methods such as GradNorm ( Chen et al., 2018b ) and PIVRG ( Qin et al., 2025 ) mitigate task imbalance through gradient- or performance-based adjustments.
In generative modeling, Improved DDPM ( Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) employs loss-aware timestep sampling, while Adaptive Non-Uniform Timestep Sampling ( Kim et al., 2025 ) learns a sampling policy based on estimated objective reduction.
Heterogeneous remote-sensing perception presents a distinct challenge: diverse sensing modalities and output structures exhibit different learning dynamics along the flow trajectory of a shared predictor.
We therefore design TMAS specifically for heterogeneous remote-sensing joint training, adapting timestep allocation to the persistent difficulty and learning activity of each task–modality group.
blocks.zh:
GradNorm(Chen等,2018b)和PIVRG(Cin等,2025)等多任务优化方法通过梯度或性能调整来缓解任务失衡.
在基因模型制作方面,改进的DDPM(Nichol和Dhariwal,2021年)采用了认识到损失的时间步抽样,而适应性非统一时间步抽样(Kim等,2025年)则学习了基于估计目标减少的抽样政策.

因此,我们专门为不同的遥感联合培训设计技术MAS,使时间步骤分配适应每个任务-模式组的持续困难和学习活动。

Figure 2: Overview of UniFlow-RS.
Native task outputs are rendered as structured visual targets and encoded by a frozen VAE. A pretrained MMDiT with one shared trainable LoRA predicts the conditional velocity field, while TMAS adapts timestep sampling from online Flow Matching errors. At inference, transport starts from the task-dependent source latent; the shared VAE decoder and deterministic recovery operators then produce native task predictions.

blocks.en: The formulation above unifies heterogeneous tasks under a shared latent predictor and Flow Matching objective, but it does not eliminate differences in their optimization dynamics.
blocks.zh: 上面的提法在共同潜在预测器和流量匹配目标下统一了各种任务,但并不能消除这些任务在优化动态方面的差异。

blocks.en: In particular, different tasks and modalities may exhibit distinct learning difficulties along the flow trajectory due to differences in output structure and sensing characteristics.
blocks.zh: 特别是,由于产出结构和感知特性的不同,不同的任务和模式在流动轨迹上可能表现出不同的学习困难。

blocks.en: A single global timestep distribution may oversample regions that are already well learned for some groups while undersampling more challenging regions for others.
blocks.zh: 单一的全球时间步分布可能会过多地取材于某些群体已经学到了良好知识的区域,而较少取材于另一些群体更具挑战性的区域。

blocks.en:
A simple solution is to sample more often from regions with larger prediction errors.
However, error magnitude alone does not tell us how a region is being learned.
A high-error region may have plateaued, whereas a moderate-error region may still be changing rapidly.
We therefore use two signals: persistent difficulty , which describes where a group remains difficult, and learning activity , which describes where its error is still changing.
TMAS estimates these signals for each task–modality group and uses them to adapt timestep sampling online.
Figure 3 gives an overview.

高发区可能已经趋于平原,而中发区可能仍在迅速变化。
因此,我们使用两个信号:持续困难(描述一个群体仍然困难的地方)和学习活动(描述其错误仍在变化的地方)。

losses, small generation errors can be amplified during deterministic instance
recovery, making detection more challenging.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented UniFlow-RS, a unified latent-flow framework for heterogeneous remote-sensing perception. Instead of sharing only representations while retaining task-specific predictors, UniFlow-RS unifies the prediction process through a pretrained flow model with a jointly trained LoRA. Structured visual targets and task-dependent conditioning enable six tasks across thirteen datasets to share the same latent prediction space and Flow Matching objective, without learned task-specific output heads or losses. To better optimize this shared predictor, TMAS adapts timestep sampling to the online learning state of each task–modality group.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了UniFlow-RS,这是一个不同遥感感知的统一潜在流动框架。 UniFlow-RS在保留特定任务预测器的同时,不只共享表示器,而是通过预先训练的流量模型与联合训练的LORA统一预测过程. 结构化的可视目标和任务依赖条件使13个数据集的6个任务能够共享相同的潜在预测空间和流量匹配目标,而无需了解特定任务的产出头或损失. 为了更好地优化这个共享的预测器,TMAS根据每个任务-模式组的在线学习状态调整了时间步抽样.

blocks.en: Across a diverse set of benchmarks, the resulting model remains competitive with task-specific methods, benefits from joint training, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization across unseen datasets, task settings, and sensing conditions without target-specific adaptation. Overall, our results demonstrate the potential of a shared generative prediction process as a foundation for generalist remote-sensing perception, and motivate further research toward more scalable and broadly transferable unified models.
blocks.zh: 在一系列不同的基准中,所产生的模型仍然具有特定任务方法的竞争力,从联合培训中获益,并显示出在不针对特定目标而进行调整的情况下,在不为所见的数据集、任务设置和感知条件方面强烈的零镜头概括。 总体而言,我们的成果显示,共享基因预测过程有可能成为泛泛遥感感知的基础,并激励进一步研究更可扩展和广泛可转让的统一模型。

blocks.en: C.3  Cross-Task Interaction
blocks.zh: C.3 跨任务互动

blocks.en: We analyze task gradients on the shared LoRA to understand how different tasks interact during joint training. At the same initialization checkpoint, we compute the gradient of each task loss with respect to the shared LoRA parameters ϕ \phi and measure the cosine similarity between task pairs: g τ = ∇ ϕ ℒ τ , ρ τ , j = g τ ⊤ ​ g j ∥ g τ ∥ 2 ​ ∥ g j ∥ 2 . g_{\tau}=\nabla_{\phi}\mathcal{L}_{\tau},\qquad\rho_{\tau,j}=\frac{g_{\tau}^{\top}g_{j}}{\lVert g_{\tau}\rVert_{2}\,\lVert g_{j}\rVert_{2}}. (17) Positive similarity indicates that two tasks favor aligned parameter updates, while negative similarity indicates conflicting update directions.

We compare UniFlow-RS with a task-specific-head variant. Both use the same frozen FLUX.2/MMDiT backbone, shared LoRA configuration, conditioning inputs, initialization checkpoint, and TMAS setting. The difference lies in their prediction interfaces: UniFlow-RS uses a unified generative predictor, whereas the variant employs independent task-specific heads.

blocks.en: We examine the contributions of learning-activity estimation and uniform exploration in TMAS. predictor preserves task-specific spatial structures across heterogeneous tasks.

On Chesapeake RSC, UniFlow-RS recovers more continuous
road structures beneath tree canopies.
On PIE, it preserves road and land-cover regions

more complete building footprints with fewer
surrounding false positives.
Together, these examples illustrate the ability
of the shared generative predictor to preserve
spatial structures across unseen task settings
and challenging observation conditions.
